findings.evidence: The Orders card value now uses revenue.orderCount, which changes with week/month/year/custom selections, while line 206 still displays stats.ordersGrowth with the fixed suffix 'tuần này'. For month, year, and custom ranges this combines metrics from different periods in one card.
findings.why_it_matters: The card can present a filtered total beside a weekly comparison, making the statistic misleading even though both individual values are valid.
findings.required_action: Make the Orders card comparison use the same selected reporting period, or remove/hide that comparison when a period-aligned value is unavailable. Do not label a weekly growth value as context for month/year/custom order totals.
